text: What numerical thermal efficiency did Sadi Carnot calculate for his ideal engine?

meta.exposure_note: exposed in git history through f819d9b; reclassified shadow-dev per Issue 1; never sealed

evidence.absent_reason: No node in the corpus states a numerical thermal efficiency computed by Sadi Carnot for his ideal engine (Reflections on the Motive Power of Fire, 1824). p:thermodynamics:00:000 and p:thermodynamics:02:000 discuss Carnot's efficiency work only qualitatively. The only numerical Carnot-efficiency figure in the corpus is in p:steam_engine:32:000 ('a theoretical Carnot efficiency of about 64%' for a modern coal-fired Rankine-cycle power station with 565 C turbine entry and 30 C condenser temperatures), which is a modern application of the Carnot formula, not a value attributed to Carnot's own calculation.
